# Contract Quality Checklist: Title-to-task

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity and consistency of the approved title, task and CLI requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist` for standard-depth pre-implementation review.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Only the reviewer marks satisfied criteria `[x]`.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means requirements quality is reviewed and satisfied; it does not mean implementation is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the supported string-title inputs and public library/CLI surfaces explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the exact task fields and boolean false value specified without optional extra fields? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the scope exclusions explicit and consistent with the standard-library-only constraint? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005; Plan §Technical Context]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is surrounding whitespace explicitly defined to include Unicode whitespace recognized by str.strip(), while internal content is preserved? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases; Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK005 Is acceptance of non-empty Unicode titles explicit for both library and CLI surfaces? [Clarity, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios 3; Spec §FR-001–FR-003]
- [ ] CHK006 Are empty and whitespace-only titles explicitly distinguished from valid titles, with ValueError defined for both library functions? [Clarity, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios 4; Spec §FR-001–FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Are success exit 0 and invalid/missing-title exit 2 specified together with the absence of successful task JSON on errors? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003–FR-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Are normalization, Unicode preservation and blank rejection consistent across the spec, data model and interface contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001–FR-004; Data Model; Contracts §Library/CLI]
- [ ] CHK009 Are JSON value equality requirements separated clearly from discretionary formatting, ordering, escaping and diagnostics? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002; Spec §Assumptions; Contracts §CLI]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Do all five acceptance scenarios have objectively defined outcomes aligned with the functional requirements? [Measurability, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios; Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK011 Are identical decoded task values, exact fields and Unicode/internal-content preservation measurable without adding unsupported behavior? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002–SC-003]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are ordinary titles, internal double spaces, surrounding ASCII/Unicode whitespace and Unicode content addressed explicitly? [Coverage, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios 1–3; Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are empty, whitespace-only and missing-title error requirements complete across their supported surfaces? [Coverage, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios 4–5; Spec §FR-004]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK014 Are the exact three-task dependency order and per-task observed red/green, checkbox, append-only canonical evidence and commit obligations unambiguous? [Consistency, Tasks §User Story 1; Tasks §Dependencies & Execution Order; Constitution §III–IV]
- [ ] CHK015 Are non-string inputs, extra arguments and presentation details explicitly outside the supported contract rather than silently added as requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Leave generated items unchecked pending reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has the separate built-in specify/clarify lifecycle.
- Add requirements-quality findings inline; this checklist does not evaluate implementation.
